calibration.outcome_definition: 1 if the club's displayed PCT is at least .500, else 0
calibration.interpretation: A lower Brier score than the flat .500 reference means the scoring profile carried information about the displayed record in this snapshot. It does not establish predictive skill for future games.

correlations.pair: Points scored per game vs Points allowed per game
Points scored per game vs Net point differential
correlations.caveat: Mechanical: net points is defined as PF minus PA and this column is PF per game, so the two series share the same scoring totals.

correlations.pair: Points scored per game vs Displayed win percentage
Points scored per game vs Actual minus expected wins
Points allowed per game vs Net point differential
correlations.caveat: Mechanical: net points is defined as PF minus PA and this column is PA per game, so the two series share the same scoring totals.

correlations.pair: Points allowed per game vs Displayed win percentage
Points allowed per game vs Actual minus expected wins
Net point differential vs Displayed win percentage
correlations.caveat: Mechanical: wins and net points move together by construction in a small sample.

correlations.pair: Net point differential vs Actual minus expected wins
correlations.caveat: Structurally induced: the expectation is computed from PF and PA, which also define net points, so the two sides are not independent measurements.

correlations.pair: Displayed win percentage vs Actual minus expected wins
correlations.caveat: Tautological: the residual subtracts a function of PF/PA from wins while PCT is wins divided by games, so both series contain the same win count.

gates.name: Provenance and contract
gates.rule: Every input row carries an official URL, a check date and an exact scope.
gates.current: PASS for the snapshot layer: 32 standings rows, 20 injury rows and 14 fixtures each carry an NFL.com URL and the 2026-11-12 check date, and are regenerated from saved text.

gates.name: Temporal integrity
gates.rule: No input may post-date the moment a projection is made.
gates.current: PASS for the originated lines: inputs are pre-kickoff (standings and injury report published before the Week 10 games). FAIL for the probability calibration, which scores models against outcomes already inside the same snapshot.

gates.name: Coverage and power
gates.rule: Adequate sample, complete universe, pre-declared scope.
gates.current: FAIL. Eight or nine games per club, one partial season, no multi-season history, and the injury sample is one game.

gates.name: Forecast quality
gates.rule: Proper scores against a stated reference, measured before any price is used.
gates.current: PARTIAL. A Brier comparison against a flat .500 reference exists for the team record; no sequential, multi-season or out-of-sample forecast evaluation exists.

gates.name: Joint dependence
gates.rule: Leg dependence measured on the actual pairing, not asserted.
gates.current: FAIL for parlays and props. No pairwise or 3+ leg joint estimate exists; only team-level cross-sectional correlations are available, which are a different quantity.

gates.name: Executable economics
gates.rule: A real, timestamped, settlement-complete price from an identified operator.
gates.current: FAIL. No sportsbook price, limit, hold or settlement rule for these NFL markets was retrieved, so ROI, CLV and stake sizing cannot be computed.

gates.name: Uncertainty and robustness
gates.rule: Uncertainty quantified and conclusions stable to reasonable choices.
gates.current: FAIL. The projections use a published exponent and a single assumed home-field constant with no interval, and no sensitivity sweep is published.

gates.name: Selection and multiple testing
gates.current: FAIL. The 10 team-level correlations are Holm-adjusted and displayed as exploratory, but no strategy search with a pre-registered family of trials exists.

gates.name: Forward shadow and risk
gates.rule: A dated, prospective, stake-capped record before any reward.
gates.current: FAIL. No forward record exists yet; the shadow ledger is specified but empty.

gates.name: Reproducibility and rights
gates.rule: Deterministic rebuild and recorded permission for the intended use.
gates.current: PASS for reproducibility (byte-identical rebuilds, hashed inputs) and OPEN for rights: NFL.com terms 1.3 restrict systematic retrieval and commercial use, so nothing here is released as a dataset or a betting service.

evaluations.name: Home spread from scoring profiles
evaluations.hypothesis: Price the home club's margin from its own scoring rate, the visitor's concession rate and a fixed home adjustment; compare with any offered line.
evaluations.failure: Ignores injuries, rest, weather, travel, quarterback changes and market movement. One assumed home-field constant cannot represent 32 clubs.

evaluations.name: Away spread mirror
evaluations.hypothesis: The same two-sided projection read from the visitor's side, used to test whether the originated number is symmetric and internally consistent.
evaluations.failure: Derived arithmetically from NS01, so it shares every weakness and cannot confirm it.

evaluations.name: Game total from combined scoring rates
evaluations.hypothesis: Sum the two conditional scoring means; compare with an offered total and its over/under prices.
evaluations.failure: Scoring rates are season-to-date and heavily influenced by opponent quality; pace and weather are absent.

evaluations.name: Record-versus-scoring regression signal
evaluations.hypothesis: Clubs whose actual record is far from their points-based expectation are candidates whose future results may move toward the expectation.
evaluations.failure: The residual is descriptive. It mixes schedule strength, special teams and luck, and the sample is one partial season.

evaluations.name: Two-leg spread plus total pair
evaluations.hypothesis: Combine NS01 and NS03 on the same game after measuring their dependence.
evaluations.failure: No joint distribution exists. Multiplying the two probabilities assumes a correlation of zero, which is exactly the assumption this project refuses to make.

evaluations.name: Cross-game two-leg parlay
evaluations.hypothesis: Combine two clubs' independent games and test whether the product of the single-leg probabilities is adequate.
evaluations.failure: Cross-game legs are plausibly independent, but that is untested here and each leg still fails its own gates.

evaluations.name: Availability-adjusted team line
evaluations.hypothesis: Adjust a club's scoring projection by which listed players are out, doubtful or questionable, using the official game-status categories.
evaluations.failure: Status is not contribution. Without depth charts, snap shares or a published starter list, an 'Out' cannot be converted into points.

evaluations.name: Next-man-up team combo
evaluations.hypothesis: When a starter is out, test whether the replacement's usage and the team's scoring change in a repeatable direction.
evaluations.failure: Requires snap counts, target shares and player logs, none of which were retrieved. No claim about a second- or third-string player is made.

leaderboard.not_applicable_rule: G05 is not applicable to single bets. It is excluded from the denominator and is never counted as a pass.
leaderboard.ranking_metric: Verified ROI lower 95% bound on a frozen common test window, with log loss as tie-break
leaderboard.empty_because: No candidate has an executable price, a joint-dependence estimate or a forward record, so no entry can be ranked.

rules: One row per pre-kickoff entry: timestamp, game, market, line, price, operator and a screenshot-free text capture of the quote.
Stake capped at a fixed fraction of a notional bankroll; no chasing and no stake increase after a loss.
Score only after settlement using the operator's published rule.
Report closing-line value and the lower confidence bound, never a single hot run.
Every entry keeps its losing rows; deleting a row disqualifies the strategy.

limitations: One partial season, eight or nine games per club.
No market prices, limits, hold or settlement rules were retrieved.
No depth chart, snap count or player game log was retrieved.
Team-level correlation is not leg-level dependence.
The NFL.com terms restrict systematic retrieval and commercial use.
